drawings.description: sous les formules, à gauche : dans un repère de deux axes, un triangle rectangle dont l'angle droit est à l'origine (un côté sur l'axe vertical, l'autre sur l'axe horizontal), hachuré de traits parallèles à l'hypoténuse, coupé par une diagonale fine issue de l'origine et par une courbe sinueuse descendant du sommet supérieur vers la base ; légendes au-dessous : « $\sigma F(n)$ » et « $\mathcal{F}(n)$ ».
drawings.kind: hatched triangle in a quadrant, with a diagonal and a wavy curve
drawings.notes: The two axes through one origin (the vertical one slightly slanted, and doubled below the origin by a second stroke just to its right), the right triangle on them (hypotenuse heavy), three hatching strokes parallel to the hypotenuse, each from the vertical axis to the base, the thin pencil diagonal from the origin to the upper right, and the wavy curve; the two legends below, placed where he wrote them. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on the 400 dpi colour crop and corrected: the wavy curve was a different shape; it is traced from the page: from a hook near the top it comes down to touch the vertical axis, swings right and down in two loops (to x 65 and x 71) and ends at the right in a small hook above the base, beyond the hypotenuse. No fourth hatching stroke is on the page (three, as drawn); the second vertical stroke below the origin is added. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite : un quadrant d'axes $p$ (horizontal) et $q$ (vertical) couvert de droites obliques parallèles montant vers la droite ; légendes : en haut à gauche « \ill{} » et « $q$ », à droite « $p$ » et « \uncertain{filtre} » ; quelques points isolés à droite.
drawings.kind: quadrant covered with parallel oblique lines
drawings.notes: The two axes, eight ink oblique strokes rising to the right (four from the vertical axis, the lowest from the origin, four from the horizontal axis; the last one slightly curved), five isolated dots at the right, and the labels q (top of the vertical axis), p and the word read « filtre » by the transcription (uncertain there; kept) at the right; the illegible word at the upper left is left out. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on the 400 dpi colour crop and redrawn: the earlier strokes were up to 4 units off in their ends and the first one started on the axis where his starts left of it; every stroke now runs between the two ends read on the page. Still differs: two thin pencil strokes between the ink ones, ending at (84.5, -26) and (88, -31.5), and a faint pencil line along the vertical axis and another above the horizontal one, are left out: their lower ends are not legible. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: feuillet retourné, au crayon : un repère d'axes $p$ (horizontal) et $q$ (vertical) ; le long de l'axe des $p$, à droite de l'origine, une bande étroite fermée à son extrémité ; légende au-dessus : « $F_0(-p)$ ».
drawings.kind: quadrant with a narrow band along the p-axis
drawings.notes: As on the page (sheet turned upside down; redrawn upright): the vertical axis with q at its top, the horizontal axis, which runs a little to the left of the origin and carries p at its right end, the narrow band along it from the vertical axis to its closed right end, and the legend F_0(-p) above. A very faint pencil line above the band is left out. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on the 400 dpi colour crop, turned upright: axes and band fall on the page; the band's lower edge moved 1 unit down at its right end, the legend F_0(-p) moved onto its place. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.orientation: sheet upside down; crop turned by 180 degrees

drawings.description: feuillet retourné, à droite du précédent, au crayon : un second repère de deux axes, traversé d'une droite oblique fine qui coupe l'axe horizontal à droite de l'origine et l'axe vertical au-dessous.
drawings.kind: pair of axes crossed by an oblique line
drawings.notes: As on the page (sheet turned upside down; redrawn upright): the two pencil axes and a thin oblique line rising to the right, which cuts the horizontal axis at the right of the origin and the vertical axis below it (it does not pass through the origin). No label. The note of the transcription calls it « une diagonale »: it is an oblique line off the origin; no consequence for the text. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on the 400 dpi colour crop, turned upright: the vertical axis is a slightly bowed stroke 1 to 2 units right of the earlier straight line, running down to -90; the oblique line's upper end 1.5 units higher; corrected. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.orientation: sheet upside down; crop turned by 180 degrees

drawings.description: marge droite, trois petites figures : un cercle pointé longé à droite par un long trait vertical ; plus haut à droite, un petit cercle pointé ; plus bas à droite, un petit ovale traversé d'une courbe épaisse.
drawings.kind: three small figures: pointed circles, one with a vertical line, an oval crossed by a curve
drawings.notes: As on the page: a circle with a point at its centre and a long vertical stroke which touches it at the right and runs down well below it; above at the right a smaller pointed circle (an upright oval); below at the right a small oval crossed by a heavy curve. Left out: the formulas written between the figures (given by the transcription). The note of the transcription says the circle is « traversé d'un trait vertical »: the stroke passes at its right edge. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on the 400 dpi colour crop and corrected: the circle is an upright oval (7.6 by 9.7 units), larger than drawn; the vertical stroke starts at -34.5 inside its right edge, not above it. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

figures.what: pointed circle with a vertical line

drawings.description: en bas à droite, deux petites figures : trois branches issues d'un même point (deux se croisant de haut en bas, une troisième horizontale vers la droite, terminée par un point) ; à droite, un petit ovale barré d'un gros trait oblique.
drawings.kind: branches through a point; an oval with a heavy stroke
drawings.notes: As on the page: two curved branches crossing at one point, from the top to the lower left and to the lower right, and a third branch from that point to the right, ended by a point; all three drawn through the one crossing point. At the right a small upright oval with a heavy oblique stroke inside it. The upper branch is gone over twice on the page: drawn once. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on the 400 dpi colour crop: the branches, the point and the oval fall on the page; unchanged. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au bas de la feuille, au crayon très pâle, deux figures : deux arcs se croisant en un point marqué ; à droite, trois traits dont deux se croisent en un point marqué sous le troisième.
drawings.kind: faint pencil figures: two arcs crossing at a marked point; three lines
drawings.notes: Very faint pencil. Left: two arcs crossing at a marked point, both drawn through that point. Right: a nearly horizontal stroke and two strokes falling from it which cross at a marked point just below it. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on the 400 dpi colour crop, contrast-enhanced: every stroke falls on the page within a unit and no further stroke belongs to the right-hand figure; unchanged. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, sous « $F$, $H^0_x(F)$ » : deux cercles pointés, le second plus grand, et plus bas à gauche un court arc.
drawings.kind: two pointed circles and a short arc
drawings.notes: As on the page: a small upright oval with a point at its centre, a larger circle with a point at its centre to its lower right, and a short arc at the lower left. The formula that runs into the crop at the bottom is left out. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on the 400 dpi colour crop and corrected: the larger figure is an upright oval (7.3 by 9 units), not a circle, 1.5 units taller at each end than drawn. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite, au-dessus de la formule « $g = 1 + \sum g_i + \sum n_s - \nu$ » : un petit ovale traversé d'une courbe montant vers la droite.
drawings.notes: As on the page: an upright oval crossed by a curve rising to the right. Left out: the curved and angular strokes at its right, which are braces tying terms of the formula below (not a figure), and the formula itself. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on the 400 dpi colour crop and corrected: the oval leans to the right (drawn rotated by 25 degrees), and the curve is nearly straight, up to 4 units right of the earlier bowed one. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: marge gauche, en bas : un cercle épais barré d'un gros trait oblique portant un point ; plus bas, un petit carré pointé, en perspective, dans un cadre en spirale.
drawings.kind: circle with a heavy stroke through a point; a pointed square in a frame
drawings.notes: Top: a heavy oval leaning to the right, crossed by a heavy oblique stroke which carries a point at the centre. Bottom, overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on the 400 dpi colour crop (contrast-enhanced) and redrawn, the earlier square and spiral being off the page by several units: a frame open at the upper left (a short stroke at the left top, a top stroke running into a large curve down the right side, ending below at the right; a separate left and bottom stroke ending in a point at the right); inside it a parallelogram open on its left side (upper edge rising to the right, right side, lower edge running back far to the lower left), a heavy vertical stroke from the top of the frame down to a point in the middle, a thin stroke from the same top point down to the left, and a stroke under it down to the lower edge. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche de « $\tilde{X}$, $X$ » : deux droites sécantes en un point marqué.
drawings.kind: two lines crossing at a marked point
drawings.notes: As on the page: two lines crossing at a marked point, both drawn through that point. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on the 400 dpi colour crop: both lines and the point fall on the page; unchanged. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite de « $k[x, y, z]/xy$ », deux figures : deux droites sécantes en un point marqué, coupées au-dessus de ce point par une troisième, plus épaisse ; à droite, deux branches courbes se coupant en un point marqué.
drawings.kind: two lines cut by a third; two curved branches meeting at a point
drawings.notes: As on the page. Left: two lines crossing at a marked point, both drawn through it, and a third, heavier, nearly horizontal line cutting both above the crossing. Right: two curved branches crossing at a marked point, both drawn through it. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on the 400 dpi colour crop and corrected: the two lines of the left figure run 3 to 4.5 units further down than drawn (bbox extended down to 0.83). Still differs: each ends in a small hook on the page, the left one shaped like an arrowhead; not drawn (whether they are arrowheads is not clear). Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
